regular_pool_buyin.description: Regular prize pool contribution per tournament entry (default: 50).

call_chips.description: Chips required to call the all-in shove (default: 10000).

losing_sessions_dollars.description: Total gross losing sessions in dollars for the tax year (default: 22000).

business_expenses_dollars.description: Qualifying Schedule C poker business expenses such as travel, lodging, and buy-in fees (default: 3500).

other_taxable_income_dollars.description: Other annual non-gambling taxable income in dollars (default: 85000).

single_tournament_net_profit_dollars.description: Net profit (payout minus buy-in) from a single poker tournament to test the $5,000 IRS Form W-2G threshold (default: 6500).

name: calculate_staking_markup_split

markup.description: Markup multiplier applied to the package (e.g. 1.00 to 1.50, default: 1.15).

action_sold_percent.description: Total percentage of action sold by the horse across all backers (default: 50).

investor_share_percent.description: Percentage share purchased by an individual investor (default: 10).

gross_cashes_dollars.description: Total gross tournament cashes and refunds at the end of the package (default: 24000).

estimated_player_roi_percent.description: Estimated true pre-markup player ROI % for EV analysis (default: 25).
